subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in normal-session max-age/max-turn automatic rotation, and what config shape plus memory/continuity contract should govern it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines public lifecycle config and behavior for preserving state across automatic resets.

options.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age/max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory, transcript, and routing continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader session boundaries
options.body: Keep #45390 open as a requirement but implement it only as part of the broader #17217/#53321 session-boundary and token-pressure design.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document cron hygiene, context-pruning, compaction, and manual reset mitigations while avoiding new core lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age/max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory, transcript, and routing continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for the product decision because he introduced daily reset policy and pre-compaction memory flush.
